"The chart titled **"Real Private Sector Credit in Domestic Currency"** tracks the month-on-month (m/m) and year-on-year (y/y) percentage changes in credit from August 2018 to February 2024.

### **Chart Components**
*   **Left Y-Axis (Percent):** Represents the **m/m** change, shown as light blue bars. The scale ranges from **-20 to 20**.
*   **Right Y-Axis (rhs):** Represents the **y/y** change, shown as a dark blue line. The scale ranges from **-50 to 40**.
*   **X-Axis:** Timeline from **Aug-18 to Feb-24**, with major intervals every six months.

### **Data Summary**
The following table provides approximate values based on the visual data points in the chart:

| Date | m/m (%) [Left Axis] | y/y (%) [Right Axis] |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Aug-18** | ~ -3% | ~ +10% |
| **Feb-19** | ~ -4% | ~ -15% |
| **Aug-19** | ~ -1% | ~ -38% |
| **Feb-20** | ~ +3% | ~ -25% |
| **Aug-20** | ~ +1% | ~ +8% |
| **Feb-21** | ~ -3% | ~ +10% |
| **Aug-21** | ~ +2% | ~ -8% |
| **Feb-22** | ~ +2% | ~ +2% |
| **Aug-22** | ~ -4% | ~ +5% |
| **Feb-23** | ~ -1% | ~ -18% |
| **Aug-23** | ~ -2% | ~ -12% |
| **Nov/Dec-23**| ~ -17.5% (Record low) | ~ -35% (Sharp drop) |
| **Feb-24** | ~ -4% | ~ -40% |

### **Key Trends**
*   **Significant Volatility:** Real credit experienced deep contractions (2019 and late 2023) and a brief period of expansion throughout 2020.
*   **Sharp Recent Decline:** There is a drastic downward spike starting in late 2023, where the month-on-month change hit a low of approximately **-17.5%**, leading the annual (y/y) change to plunge to **-40%** by February 2024."
